result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now runs the same code path as `updateLandscape`, with the same options. It compiles (`mvn -o -pl cli compile`), but I didn't run any tests. I also didn't run the command to check that it creates `config.json` and `index.html`.

- **`Commands.java`**: I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE_DESCRIPTION`. The description calls it the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and says it is the same as `updateLandscape`. `usageInfo` now lists `analyzeLandscape` before `updateLandscape`, using the same options.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: `run` sends both names to `updateLandscape(args)`. In that method, `-help` prints the usage and description for whichever name was typed, so `updateLandscape -help` prints exactly what it did before.
- **`README.md`**: The README had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Command line" section. It documents `analyzeLandscape` and notes that `updateLandscape` is the same command, kept for existing scripts.
